content: Yeisu ina bodao sikaaiyakaTauyana yaina be tomota simatakoiyedi
Yeisu tuwaina kana, ‘Yau oine buyalina mooitamoina go, yau Tamagu tobágula.

Laonigowo tamo tamo neta siteliteli, geya sikeuwoita, tobagulayana ikaimweraedi. Go laonigowo tamo tamo neta sikéuwo, keuwoidi ikabidi go, laonigowoyadi ilaiguyedi bego silabosúsuwo be sikéuwo gagaina.
Komi laonigowoyami nakae bogina komavada guna livala boi alatuuwokoimi pasina.

Komi yaigu goi kokaaiyāka go, yau nakae yaimi goi akaaiyaka. Láwana geya itoboineyeta bei toinina ikéuwo, go sem neta búyala goi ikaaiyaka, itoboine ikéuwo. Komi nakae, geya itoboinemita toinimi goi kokéuwo, go sem neta yaigu goi kokaaiyaka, itoboinemi.
Yau oine buyalina. Komi laonigowo. Avatauwa komi neta yaigu goi kokaaiyaka be yaimi goi akaaiyaka, komi bei kokéuwo gagaina. Neta yau geya, geya tayaamo kaga itoboinemi koguinuwe.
Avatauwa neta geya sikaiyaketa yau yaigu goi, lawanayadi geya basabasaidimo nakae tobágula ikalebaledi go, simémala namliyeta ina topaisewayao siwotuwedi sigabudi.
Neta kokaaiyaka yau yaigu goi be nakae guna livala yaimi goi sikaaiyaka, kaga latuwomi, manuna kokawanōi, bei kobabane.
Neta kokéuwo gagaina, komi moitamo yau guna tovatotowanayao. Moeko goi yau Tamagu ina togaga ana káeyana mooitamoina kovagitakoe tomota yaidi goi.
Yau amatakoiyemi nakae Tamagu bogina imatakoiyegu. Guna matakoiyana goi kokaaiyāka.
Neta guna lovina kokabikaaonedi, guna matakoiyana goi kokaaiyaka. Moe yau nakae; Tamagu ina lovina bogina akabikaonedi, e ina matakoi goi akaaiyaka.
Moe livalayadi bogina alatuwokoimi bego guna uyáwana yaimi goi ikaaiyaka be imi uyáwana ivakayaodeimi.
Ame yau guna lovina: Semiyao komatakooiyēdi nakae yau bogina amatakooiyemi.
Geya vatau tayaamo ina matakoi matakoi ame nakae ivakaigagasave: Bego semiyao manudi yawoimi kokasale.
Komi yau segowo neta kaga yau aloviinaemi koguinuwe.

Tomota paakonina geya iyagoiyeta kaga ina tomoya iguinuwe, tauna boi avayokoimi komi guna pakonayao nakae go, ame tuta avayokoimi segowo. E kaga liliuna yau Tamagu ilatuuwokoigu, bogina alatuwokoimi koyagoi, tauna avayokoimi segowo.

Boi komi geya kokinaveguta bego yau komi imi Tomoya, go sem yau akinavemi be avayokoimi komi yau guna tovatotowanayao. Avayokoimi bego komi kona kokéuwo go, keuwoimiyadi sikaiyako vata bego kaga yoigu goi kokawanoiye Tamada yaina, bei ivinimi.
Moe lovinayadi bogina avinimi bego semiyao komatakooiyēdi.’
Da poyapoya Yeisu ina bodaosivakaleyedi go, Baloma Kimaasabaina bei ivaitedi
Yeisu tuwaina kana, ‘Neta da poyapoya sikaoliilivemi, konuwāisi bego yau bogina sigimikaolilivegu.
Neta da poyapoya taiyao koeboda tayamo, tauyadi bei simatakoiyemi. Go komi geya koebodeta tayamo tauyadi taiyao, go sem yaidi goi akinavemi, tauna bei sikaolilivemi.

Guna livala boi yau alatuuwokoimi konuwokavāte, kagu, “Tomota paakonina ina tomoya geya itobusaveyeta.” Tomota siyogedegedegu, tauna neta guna livala kokabiikaone, bei siyogedegedemi. Neta tauyadi guna livala sikabikaone, komi imi livala nakae bei sikabikaone go, geya sikabikaoneyeta,
go sem moe dogoiyadi bei siguinuwedi yaimi goi unana yau yoigu ikaaiyaka yaimi. Idi guinuwayadi unana guna Toetuna geya siyagoiyeta, tauna nakae siguinuwe.
Neta boi geya amaita be nakae guna livala geya alatuwokoidita, geya idi goyomo. Ego guna livalayana bogina alatuwokoidi go, geya sikabikaoneyeta, tauna geya itoboinedita idi goyo silawoiwoiyedi.
Avatauwa neta sikaoliilivegu, yau Tamagu nakae sikaoolilive.

Boi guna guinuwa yaidi goi aguuinuwedi go, geya vatau tayaamo nakae iguinuwedi. Ago neta yaidi goi geya aguinuwedita, geya idi goyomo. Ego ame bogina madi goyo unana guna guinuwayadi bogina sigitedi go, yau ma Tamagu sikaolilivema. Taabu ame manuna kokaaliwōisa.
Go sem livala ame idi Gínina Kimaasabaidi goi siginigini itoboine imalatomotamna, idigo kana,
“Geya unanamo go, sikaolilivegu.” Same 35:19, 69:4
Tovapísiya Tamada goi aetune ima yaimi. Tutayana ima, bei italavaitegu. Tovapisiyayana, moe Yaubada ana Nanamsa Mooitamoina ana tovagitákwana, Tamada goi ima.
E yau guna paisewa ana kaba vatowo goi ima ame tuta komi taiyao takaaiyaka, tauna komi nakae bei kotalavaitegu.’
